# Errors

Errors extend `RpcErrorBase` and expose stable categories such as timeout, network, rate_limit and invalid_response.

```ts
try {
  await rpc.call('namespace.method')
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof RpcErrorBase) {
    console.log(error.category, error.retryable, error.failoverable)
  }
}
```

Use structured categories and retry/failover hints rather than parsing error messages.
